snippet.title: In Search of the Ice Pop - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://s.team/a/2775540/
Developer: https://bsky.app/profile/cguanpeng.com

"In Search of the Ice Pop" is a story of modern melancholy, a short, nostalgic visual novel about a forgotten ice pop — and the girl who once felt like a big sister to you.

On a suffocating summer night, hopelessness wandered around your place like a ghost. On the way to your shift at the convenience store, a piece of memory struck you out of the blue — the big sis who took you to the arcade 15 years ago. Where is she now?
